name: mathup-platforma-bacalaureat
description: Monorepo MathUP — frontend React (Vite) + backend Supabase

scripts.docker:up:local: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile local up --build --force-recreate supabase-start frontend
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile local --profile local-down --profile preview down --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose --profile local --profile local-down --profile preview down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose up --build frontend
